meta.title: Contact and support — Palsya
meta.description: Ask Palsya anything. Support answers in your language, usually within one working day.

hero.title: Ask us anything
hero.lead: Support answers in your language. If you have a plan with consultations, clinical questions are better on a call than in an email — book one instead.
hero.subtitle: Support by email in your language, consultations by video
hero.lead2: You do not have to work through recovery on your own. Help is a message away.

urgent.strong: Do not use this form for anything urgent.
urgent.body: Eye pain, redness, or changed vision needs a doctor today. Facial weakness with limb weakness, confusion, or trouble speaking is an emergency — call your local emergency number.

emails.hello: One working day. Four hours on plans with consultations.
emails.privacy: Data access, export, deletion. Our DPO reads this.

camera.b: Scans need a secure connection and camera permission. Check the padlock in your address bar, then your browser's camera setting for this site. On iPhone, Safari is the most reliable choice.

tape.b: Almost always skin preparation. No moisturiser, sunscreen, or make-up underneath, skin fully dry, and rub the strip for ten seconds after applying to activate the adhesive.

plan.t: I want to change or cancel my plan
plan.b: Settings → Subscription. Cancelling takes two clicks and there is no retention call. Cancelling during the free trial means no charge at all.

data.t: I need my data, or I want it deleted
data.b: Settings → Privacy and data. Export gives you everything in a portable format. Deletion is permanent and clears your images within 30 days.

worried.t: Something about my recovery worries me
worried.b: If it is your eye — pain, redness, or changed vision — see a doctor today, not us. For anything else, book a consultation or message your clinician.

form.title: Send us a message
form.messageHint: The more specific, the more useful our answer will be.
form.note: We use what you send only to answer you. Nothing here is added to a marketing list.
form.respond: We reply within one working day.

errors.fill: Please fill in your name, email, and message.
errors.email: That email address does not look right.
errors.tooLong: Your message is too long. Please keep it under {max, number} characters.
errors.rateLimited: You have sent several messages in a short time. Please wait a while and try again, or email us directly.
errors.failed: Your message could not be sent. Please try again, or email us directly.

sent.title: Message sent
sent.body: Thank you. A person will reply in {language}, usually within one working day.

cta.title: Get guided support for facial paralysis and take the next step in your recovery.
cta.lead: Seven days free. Nothing to install, and you can cancel in two clicks.

location: Based in Lisbon and Amsterdam, supporting people across Europe.

banner.alt: Three faces showing facial symmetry returning over time
